title: Project Intelligence Console Graph Snapshot Generator v0.1
objective: Implement the first local-only Project Intelligence Console foundation by generating bounded JSON graph snapshots for docs relationships, code ownership, and project progress from repository files, without building a hosted dashboard or changing website design.
acceptance: Generate local-only graph snapshot JSON for docs graph, code ownership graph, and project progress graph.
Keep graph snapshots under an ignored/generated artifact boundary.
Validate source coverage, schema shape, bounded output size, and redaction/no secret leakage.
Do not implement hosted dashboard, SaaS runtime, telemetry, upload, deployment, or website visual redesign.
Update operations docs, testing strategy, acceptance checklist, decision log, dev log, and progress snapshot.
